Our Mandate

Our mandate in serving our Members is to:

  • Promote excellence and professionalism in microwave radio frequency coordination activities.
  • Support our Member organizations in microwave radio frequency coordination activities with each other and with other Canadian and U.S. organizations.
  • Provide our Member organizations with an effective internal forum for the development of frequency coordination procedures and spectrum management policies.

Frequency Coordination System Association (FCSA)
